story: Product Owner Orders action -> protected same-origin POST -> fixed one-Medium Shopify checkout preparation; no payment/order submission and no public checkout activation.
visibility: background; no focus or foreground window

findings.message: Product Owner Orders route returns HTTP 200.
Product Owner sees exactly one controlled checkout action.
The action discloses that opening checkout cannot charge or order.
The Orders warning truthfully discloses the temporary Shopify cart mutation.
The selected existing order path is explained.
Product Owner Orders route has no horizontal overflow.
Product Owner Orders route renders meaningful content without an error overlay.
Product Owner Orders route exposes no raw Shopify or provider reference.
Product Owner Orders route has no critical or serious automated accessibility violations.
Product Owner Orders route emits no console errors.
Product Owner Orders route has no failed requests.
Reviewer retains read-only Orders visibility.
Reviewer cannot see the Product Owner action.
Reviewer receives no controlled-order form.
